newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse has upside potential - Sofres poll.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse has upside potential - Sofres poll.

text.p: The French stockmarket has upside potential founded on expectations of further interest rate cuts, according to a Sofres poll of market operators published on Tuesday in the newspaper La Tribune.
A majority of the operators surveyed, 58 percent, said they expected further gains in the bourse, which reached all-time highs last week and is trading near those levels.
That figure is down slightly from a poll in October, when 64 percent of market operators expected further gains.
La Tribune said the remaining third mostly expected the market to stabilise.
Pollsters Sofres surveyed 140 market professionals -- analysts, portfolio managers and traders -- on January 16 and 17.
